As a long time is gone and i free from any pregnancy so will i marry to that person of pakistan dierect after divorce Or either i will have to wait for Iddat period but i am already free from pregnancy as he didn't touched me more for more than fr problem is that the pakistani person is going back to his country and may impossible to come back again. Please help in the light of islamic views. Jazakumullah Answer ID: 8267 Posted on: Sep 1, 2020 Bismillah hir-Rahman nir-Rahim ! (Fatwa: 1783/1679=D/1429) When you remarried you former husband, you will remain her wife unless he divorces you or you get khula . You can not marry any other man. However, if he is not giving you your rights and violates your due rights, then you can put an application against him in a Shariah court. The Shariah court, after investigation in light of the Shariah, will nullify the nikah , and you may marry any other man after passing the iddah . We do not know whether the process of nullifying nikah according to the Shariah is going on in the court of your area or not. Therefore, you should ask the Ulma there about it. You should note that you will have to complete the iddah (three menses) even after nullification of nikah by the Shariah court in accordance with Quran and Hadith. No matter, if your husband has touched you for a long time or not, or you have been away from him, you will have to accomplish the iddah . Allah (Subhana Wa Ta'ala) knows Best Darul Ifta, Darul Uloom Deoband, India
